from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class AssetRecord(BaseModel):
    """One financial asset record extracted from a single company's filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The legal name of the company the filing belongs to")
    asset_label: str | None = Field(description="The line-item label used for this asset, e.g. 'Total Assets'")
    amount_value: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the asset as reported")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the reported amount, e.g. 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    period_end: str | None = Field(description="The date this financial position was reported as of")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    asset_records: list[AssetRecord]
